root_cause: Canonical registry primary intents were not consistently reflected in source page titles, leaving genuine title/H1 ownership gaps after the validator contract was corrected.
The legacy claim detector treated a more-specific explicit keyword as also claiming a shorter parent keyword, creating false cannibalization.
The sitemap audit required canonical alias source routes to appear independently even when their canonical points at another indexable route.
prevention: Primary registry keywords must be represented in the owning page title or H1.
Explicit bg keyword ownership is exact; a more-specific keyword must not implicitly claim its parent keyword.
Canonical aliases are excluded from independent sitemap-presence requirements.
